# SMBAct MCP error codes

A failed tool call is a tool result with `isError: true` and the text `{"error": "<code>", "message": "…"}`. Read `message`: it names the argument, the display or the window.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `invalid_params` | The arguments are wrong. `place_windows` names the placement and the key (`placement 2: "width": …`). |
| `invalid_window_state` | A window that is not normal with `state: "keep"`; a state that did not leave in time; a state that changed during the request. |
| `display_not_found` | `move_window_to_display`, `place_windows`: no display with that index, name or id (or an ambiguous name); the message lists the displays. |
| `duplicate_target` | `place_windows`: two placements name the same window explicitly (an id twice, `active` twice, an id that is the active window plus `active`); nothing moved. |
| `ambiguous_target` | `place_windows` with `on_multiple: "error"`: several windows match; the message lists up to 10. |
| `window_not_placeable` | A zero-size window (an orphaned frame). |
| `window_on_other_desktop` | `place_windows`: the window is on a desktop that is not showing (macOS cannot place it there; `desktop: "refuse"` everywhere). |
| `target_offscreen` | `place_windows`, `set_window_frame`: the frame would leave no grabbable part of the title bar on any work area (`allow_offscreen` lifts it). |
| `constraint` | `place_windows` with `strict`: the window ended outside the tolerance. |
| `busy` | Five placement requests are already queued. |
| `rate_limited` | More than 10 placement requests a second (bursts of 20), per entry point. |
| `engine_unavailable` | The window engine is restarting with another backend, or has failed (restart SMBAct). |
| `unsupported`, `interrupted`, `failed`, `internal` | The OS cannot do it; SMBAct is quitting; the native call failed (its text); a bug. |
| `tool_unavailable` | The tool is switched off. |
| `license_required` | No active license or running trial. |
| `window_not_found` | No window with that id. |
| `window_not_allowed` | The window is SMBAct's own. |
| `window_black_listed` | The app is on the SMBAct black list. |
| `declined` | The user refused the close. |
| `app_not_ready` | SMBAct is still starting. |
| `timeout` | SMBAct did not answer in time. |
